title: Joint Optimization of Tool Creation and Use for Large Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.24571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-augmented language models are bounded by the APIs humans bothered to write; existing tool-creation systems patch this by prompting a frozen LLM at inference time, leaving the model that writes a tool decoupled from the one that uses it, with no signal that the schemas it produces are schemas it can invoke. We propose SMITH (Schema-grounded Multi-task Iterative Tool Honing), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly trains tool creation and tool use inside a single policy. Each rollout is either a build task (write a tool from a few examples) or a use task (invoke a pooled tool on a held-out question). Three separate reward axes catch schema, code, and outcome failures independently, so each failure mode contributes its own gradient. translated_title: 大型语言模型代理的工具创建与使用联合优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24571v1 公告类型：新 摘要：工具增强型语言模型受限于人类编写的API；现有的工具创建系统通过在推理时提示冻结的LLM来修补这一缺陷，导致编写工具与使用工具的模型相互分离，且没有信号表明其生成的模式是可调用的。我们提出SMITH（基于模式的多任务迭代工具打磨），一种强化学习框架，在单个策略中联合训练工具创建和工具使用。每次迭代要么是构建任务（从几个示例中编写工具），要么是使用任务（在预留问题上调用池化工具）。三个独立的奖励轴分别捕捉模式、代码和结果失败，因此每种失败模式贡献其自身的梯度。使用SMITH在13个具有精确验证器的程序推理任务上训练的4B Qwen3，在预留任务上达到79.8的宏平均准确率，在所有评估方法中表现最佳，且优于未训练的模型。
tldr: 本文提出SMITH框架，通过强化学习联合优化工具创建与使用，使单一策略同时学习编写和调用工具，显著提升程序推理任务的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SMITH framework, which jointly optimizes tool creation and use via reinforcement learning, enabling a single policy to both write and invoke tools, significantly improving accuracy on procedural reasoning tasks.
